name: MoE Routing Explorer
description: Linked single-layer rank routing and single-token whole-network journey views for dense MoE traces.

source.visualContract: Generated SVG geometry, Top-K routing spokes, weighted-sum path, rank load state, and anchored tooltip behavior are owned by pattern.js.

useWhen: comparing token load across 256 routed experts placed on 128 ranks at one MoE layer
following one token through Dense L0-L1 and MoE L2-L45
embedding MoE routing evidence inside a PTO workbench without duplicating page chrome
allowedOverrides: initial view, layer, token, active rank slice, language, and theme
forbiddenOverrides: reimplementing expert geometry or weighted-sum routing in a consuming page
using an iframe when the renderer can be mounted directly
drawing page-local toolbar or theme chrome when embedded in ide-frame
changing gray inactive, foreground Top-K, primary weighted-sum, warning overload, or light-mode stripe semantics outside the pattern
agentReuseRule: Load shared PTO tokens, pattern.css, a compatible routing-data provider, and pattern.js. Mount with showChrome:false inside ide-frame and drive layer/token/view through the controller.
